sections.overview: A marine Liparidae snailfish known from the western North Atlantic south of Greenland.
sections.identification: Its prominent dark head and triangular opercular flap are noted in the species description.
sections.habitat: It is associated with deep water, although reported sampling depths do not establish a full habitat range.
sections.diet: The consulted accounts do not document its diet.
sections.behavior: The consulted accounts give no species-specific behavior.
sections.reproduction: No reproductive observations are reported in the consulted accounts.
sections.ecology: Records are few; a Greenland checklist describes it as very rare and pelagic. P. mirabilis is another western North Atlantic congener; its dark head and belly contrast with the blackish head noted for this species.
sections.conservation: The consulted sources do not provide a current conservation assessment.
